tools.name: invite_vendor_to_ticket
tools.description: Creates a time-limited guest access link that lets an outside vendor view one ticket, then emails that invitation link to the vendor.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket the vendor should see.

params.name: vendor_email
params.description: Email address of the vendor contact.

params.name: expires_in_hours
params.description: How many hours the guest link stays valid.

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
import requests
from agents import function_tool

HELPDESK_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("HELPDESK_API_BASE_URL", "https://helpdesk.internal/api/v2")
HELPDESK_API_TOKEN = os.environ["HELPDESK_API_TOKEN"]
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.internal")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ["SMTP_USER"]
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"]
SUPPORT_FROM_ADDRESS = os.environ.get("SUPPORT_FROM_ADDRESS", "support@example.com")


@function_tool
def invite_vendor_to_ticket(ticket_id: str, vendor_email: str, expires_in_hours: int = 72) -> dict:
    response = requests.post(
        f"{HELPDESK_API_BASE_URL}/tickets/{ticket_id}/guest-access",
        json={"email": vendor_email, "scope": "ticket:read", "expires_in_hours": expires_in_hours},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {HELPDESK_API_TOKEN}"},
        timeout=15,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    grant = response.json()
    invite_link = grant["access_url"]

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["Subject"] = f"You've been invited to support ticket {ticket_id}"
    message["From"] = SUPPORT_FROM_ADDRESS
    message["To"] = vendor_email
    message.set_content(
        f"Hello,\n\nYou have been given read access to support ticket {ticket_id}.\n"
        f"Open it here: {invite_link}\n\nThis link expires in {expires_in_hours} hours.\n"
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        smtp.send_message(message)

    return {
        "ticket_id": ticket_id,
        "vendor_email": vendor_email,
        "grant_id": grant.get("id"),
        "expires_at": grant.get("expires_at"),
        "invite_sent": True,
    }

tools.name: post_escalation_alert_to_slack
tools.description: Posts an escalation alert about a ticket to the support team's Slack channel, including the ticket ID, priority, and a short summary.

params.name: summary
params.description: One-line summary of why the ticket is escalated.

tools.code:
import os
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")

WEBHOOK = os.environ["SLACK_ESCALATION_WEBHOOK_URL"]
URL = os.environ.get("HELPDESK_UI_URL", "https://helpdesk.internal/tickets")


@mcp.tool()
def post_escalation_alert_to_slack(ticket_id: str, priority: str, summary: str) -> dict:
    p = priority.lower()
    em = {"urgent": ":rotating_light:", "high": ":warning:"}.get(p, ":bell:")
    txt = f"{em} *Escalation* <{URL}/{ticket_id}|#{ticket_id}> [{p}]\n{summary}"
    r = requests.post(WEBHOOK, json={"text": txt}, timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return {"ticket_id": ticket_id, "posted": True}
